title: Green Bank Telescope

terrainReference.basis: USGS bare earth sampled at the observatory-surveyed support axis. The separately surveyed track elevation defines the wheel landing plane.

identities.name: Green Bank Telescope
identities.address: Green Bank Observatory, 155 Observatory Road, Green Bank, West Virginia, United States

mapIdentity.scope: Observatory-surveyed support axis, mapped operating area, and the original USGS one-metre grade. The Observatory and NRAO provide the reflector dimensions, axle elevation, and track diameter.

note: An open steel support cradle sits below the elevated 100 by 110 metre asymmetrical reflecting surface. An off-axis trussed arm carries the subreflector outside the collecting aperture.
